influences.name: Maya Angelou
influences.context: his mother, "The Jeffersons" actress Roxie Roker, was a peer to pivotal Black artists like Maya Angelou, Nikki Giovanni, Miles Davis, Ella Fitzgerald, and Duke Ellington, meaning Kravitz grew up surrounded by those that "were using their art, in so many cases, to push the cause"
